fail_rules: If the image reads as abstract, atmosphere-first, texture-only, or subjectless, it must FAIL.
If the image does not read as a manufactured object immediately, it must FAIL.
Check saturation: reject neon, RGB-clean, or oversaturated reads.
Check color harmony: reject pure white, pure black, and synthetic magenta drift.
Check material-color match: color must feel materially bonded, never flat digital fill.
fix_direction: The image must depict a clear, manufactured object.
The material must be porcelain-white matte ceramic.
Remove all abstract elements and focus on material readability.
Desaturate colors significantly and establish a shadow-heavy, low-saturation palette.
Eliminate neon and plastic color drifts.
Introduce clear contour evidence (edge, rim, bevel, seam, curvature) to define the object.
summary: The image is an abstract, highly saturated, noisy purple and black texture that completely fails to represent a white ceramic material study or any discernible manufactured object.
